rules.title: SOUP item has no title
rules.msg: SOUP item has no title. 8.1.2 asks for the title of each SOUP configuration item.

rules.title: Manufacturer of the SOUP item is not recorded
rules.msg: "{item}": manufacturer is not recorded. 8.1.2 asks for title, manufacturer and unique SOUP designator.

rules.title: Unique SOUP designator (version) is not recorded
rules.msg: "{item}": no version recorded. 8.1.2 asks for the unique SOUP designator — the exact version you shipped.

rules.title: Version is a range, not a unique designator
rules.msg: "{item}": version "{value}" is a range or a pointer, not a unique designator. Record the exact version that went into the build.

rules.title: Functional and performance requirements for the SOUP item are missing
rules.msg: "{item}": no functional and performance requirements. 5.3.3 asks what this SOUP item must do for your device.

rules.title: Hardware and software required by the SOUP item are missing
rules.msg: "{item}": no hardware/software requirements. 5.3.4 asks what this SOUP item needs to run (OS, runtime, driver, memory).

rules.title: No software safety class on the SOUP item
rules.msg: "{item}": no software safety class. 4.3 classifies each software item A, B or C, and SOUP inherits the class of the item that uses it.

rules.title: Software safety class is not A, B or C
rules.msg: "{item}": safety class "{value}" is not A, B or C. 4.3 allows those three classes only.

rules.title: Published anomaly list was never evaluated
rules.msg: "{item}": the published anomaly list was not evaluated. 7.1.3 asks you to read the supplier's known-bug list and judge whether any anomaly can contribute to a hazardous situation.

rules.title: Anomaly-list evaluation carries no date
rules.msg: "{item}": the anomaly-list evaluation carries no date. An undated evaluation cannot be tied to the version you shipped.

rules.title: Anomaly-list evaluation is older than 365 days
rules.msg: "{item}": anomaly list last evaluated {value} — {days} days ago. New anomalies published since then have not been judged.

rules.title: Anomaly-list evaluation is dated in the future
rules.msg: "{item}": anomaly-list evaluation is dated {value}, which is after today ({today}). An auditor reads a future date as a record written from memory.

rules.title: A required field still holds a placeholder
rules.msg: "{item}": {field} still says "{value}". A placeholder in the technical file is a missing record.

rules.title: The same SOUP item is listed twice
rules.msg: "{item}" is listed more than once (versions: {value}). Two rows for one item means the auditor cannot tell which one shipped.

rules.title: The SOUP table has no column for a required record
rules.msg: The SOUP table has no {field} column, so no item can carry that record ({clause}).

rules.title: No SOUP items found in the file
rules.msg: No SOUP items found. 8.1.2 asks for a list of SOUP configuration items; an empty list is only true if your device has no third-party code.
